1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Low relief and broad hot intervals; each deliberate strike reveals a new settled contact state.

2.label: easy
2.summary: Greater displacement and rotating coordinates require estimating local direction at each settled pose.

3.label: medium
3.summary: A through-eye and raised shoulder couple draw/upset choices to vertical headroom across changing settled heat states.

4.label: hard
4.summary: No spare metal; larger pose changes and shorter independent heating intervals require deliberate state-by-state planning.

5.label: very_hard
5.summary: Four-height relief with a through-eye; nonperiodic translation, rotation and independently changing cell heat combine spatial routing with comparison of settled previews.

full.summary: Drag the physical hammer from its dock onto a settled contact face. Click target die squares to gauge concealed layers; measurements persist in both modes without advancing the forge.

simplified.summary: Click the same settled contact face; no auto-aim and waiting does not advance the forge. Click target die squares to gauge concealed layers; measurements persist in both modes without advancing the forge.
